verdict.rationale: Elicit is an AI research tool, so a training opt-out is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The pack covers search, systematic reviews, exports, the API and MCP, but nothing on model-training data use, opt-out controls or data-retention policies. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none.
